task: Add provider-neutral governance and task-stage model routing with fail-closed locality, conservative resource accounting, durable provider intent handling, and explicit terminal stop closures.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAI and Claude responses record normalized provider usage or an explicit conservative usage-unavailable estimate without inventing exact counts.
Task-stage routing selects only constructed eligible adapters, falls back deterministically when a preferred adapter is unavailable, and keeps provider branches out of workflow orchestration.
Unknown, restricted, or endpoint-incompatible evidence classification is denied before any provider receives content, using configurable provider and endpoint locality policy.
Per-run token and cost budgets reset for each workflow trigger while durable per-canvas accounting prevents restart-based budget bypass.
Unknown pricing, missing usage, reservation denial, and post-response budget overshoot fail closed and permit no subsequent provider or canvas writes.
Durable provider intents honor terminal status and next_retry_at, distinguish deterministic from transient or ambiguous failures with typed SDK errors, and prevent blind duplicate submission.
Max rounds, token, cost, wall-time, no-progress, locality denial, and reservation denial produce distinct audited and rendered closure outcomes.

The lab-agent test, lint, and type-check suites pass with regression coverage for adapter fallback, locality, accounting, retry scheduling, duplicate-submit prevention, threshold overshoot, and no-write-after-stop behavior.

Architecture, roadmap, operations, canonical specification, changelog, and configuration documentation accurately describe the implemented governance boundaries and external approval and pricing gates.
blastRadius: provider adapter response and error contracts
evidence locality authorization before model calls
per-run and per-canvas token and cost accounting
durable provider intent retry and reconciliation
canvas write ordering after governance thresholds
contracts: Workflow orchestration remains provider-neutral and calls models through the governed adapter gateway.
Unauthorized or unknown evidence never reaches a provider endpoint.
Audits store provider, model, request ids, counts, classifications, decisions, pricing version, and reasons without prompts, secrets, or provider response bodies.
Provider usage is exact only when supplied by the SDK; unavailable usage is explicitly labeled and conservatively enforced.
Durable intent status and retry timing prevent completed, terminal, ambiguous, or not-yet-due requests from blind redispatch.
No provider or canvas write occurs after a terminal governance stop.
Existing CLI, watcher, durable harness, grounding, and Browser artifact behavior remain backward compatible unless governed policy intentionally denies execution.
